name: Simon
summary: A man of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, who was coming in from the country as Jesus was led away. The soldiers made him carry Jesus' cross.

key_moments.title: Carries Jesus' Cross
key_moments.description: As Jesus was led away to be crucified, they seized Simon, a Cyrenian passing by on his way in from the country. They laid the cross on him and made him carry it behind Jesus.
